name: screen-video
description: Plan a screen video of a web app, a macOS app, or an app on the iOS Simulator or the Android emulator with your agent, check it as a storyboard of pictures, and record it into narrated videos with quiet music, a themed frame, title and chapter cards, and a zoom on each action, as 16:9, 9:16, and GIF, blurring private values and stopping before steps that send something or pay
